`SKILL.md`, `LICENSE.txt` and the four `examples/*.md` files are unchanged upstream copies.
`upstream-lock.json` records their exact byte hashes. No upstream NOTICE file was present in the
reviewed skill directory or repository root. The root THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md was also reviewed;
its listed software/font components are not bundled in these six text files. See upstream-lock.json
for the locked root-notice hash. This notice, lock and approval template are local additions.
The template's Chinese matching/scope guidance is separate local adaptation, not official Anthropic text.

The template is deliberately unapproved (`approvedBy` is empty). The task author authorized the
source-specific import demonstration; the demonstration records Codex as an automated reviewer
acting under that task authorization, not as a named human approver. Future administrators must
review these files and supply their own genuine approval identity. No endorsement is implied.
